name: Tiendanube / Nuvemshop
description: Tiendanube (Nuvemshop in Brazil) online stores: store info, products, variants and stock, categories, orders and fulfillment orders, customers, abandoned checkouts, coupons and webhooks. REST API 2025-03 with an app access token.
instructions:
## Tiendanube / Nuvemshop
This connector talks to the Tiendanube REST API (Nuvemshop in Brazil, same platform and same API), version `2025-03`, at `https://api.tiendanube.com/2025-03/<store id>`. Every request goes to one store.

## Credentials
Tiendanube has no API keys in the store admin: access is granted to an app. To get a token for your own store:
1. Register at the Tiendanube or Nuvemshop Partners portal and create an app under **Apps**. Choose the scopes you need (`read_products`, `write_products`, `read_orders`, `write_orders`, `read_customers`, `read_coupons`...); a write scope includes its read scope.
2. Install the app on your store by opening `https://www.tiendanube.com/apps/<app id>/authorize`. You are redirected to the app's redirect URL with a `code` (valid 5 minutes).
3. Exchange it: `POST https://www.tiendanube.com/apps/authorize/token` with `client_id`, `client_secret`, `grant_type=authorization_code` and `code`. The answer has `access_token` (put it in `TIENDANUBE_ACCESS_TOKEN`) and `user_id`, which is the store id (put it in `TIENDANUBE_STORE_ID`).
Tokens do not expire; they stop working when a new one is issued for the same app or the app is uninstalled.

The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Older integrations use the legacy header `Authentication: bearer <token>`, which the API still accepts; a token works with either. Tiendanube also requires a `User-Agent` with the app name and a contact; without it the API answers 400. The connector sends `AnythingMCP (support@anythingmcp.com)`.

## Start here
`tiendanube_get_store` returns the store name, languages, currency and plan. Then `tiendanube_list_orders` or `tiendanube_list_products`.

## Pagination and limits
- Lists return 30 items by default; `per_page` goes up to 200, `page` starts at 1. The total count is in the `x-total-count` header and the next page in the `Link` header (both returned in `_headers` / `_pagination`).
- Order queries stop at 10,000 results: narrow them with `created_at_min` / `created_at_max` or a status filter.
- Rate limit: a leaky bucket of 40 requests draining at 2 per second per store and app (10x on Next and Evolution plans). Over it the API returns 429.

## Data conventions
- Ids are integers. Product variants have their own ids; stock and price live on the variant, not on the product.
- Product and category names, descriptions and handles are objects keyed by language (`{"es": "...", "pt": "..."}`). When creating, pass such an object or a plain string, which is applied to every language.
- Money values are strings with two decimals (`"5400.00"`) in the store currency (`currency` on the order).
- Dates are ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. `2026-09-01T00:00:00-03:00`.
- Orders have three separate states: `status` (open, closed, cancelled), `payment_status` (pending, authorized, paid, abandoned, refunded, voided) and `shipping_status` (unpacked, unfulfilled, fulfilled).

## Pitfalls
- `published` and `visibility` on products cannot be sent together (422); this connector uses `visibility`.
- A 402 means the store's API access is suspended for an unpaid subscription.
- `tiendanube_cancel_order` restocks and e-mails the customer by default.
prerequisites: Needs an access token from a Tiendanube/Nuvemshop app installed on your store: create the app in the Partners portal, install it, and exchange the code for a token. The store id is the `user_id` returned with the token.

TIENDANUBE_STORE_ID.label: Store id
TIENDANUBE_STORE_ID.help: The numeric store id: the user_id returned together with the access token. It is also shown in the Partners portal under the store where the app is installed.
TIENDANUBE_STORE_ID.patternMessage: The store id is a number, e.g. 817495.

TIENDANUBE_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access token
TIENDANUBE_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: The access_token returned by POST https://www.tiendanube.com/apps/authorize/token after installing your app on the store. Paste the token only, without 'bearer'.
TIENDANUBE_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token (letters and digits), without the word bearer.

verifyHints.401: Tiendanube refused the token. It stops working when the app is uninstalled or a new token is issued for the same app; install the app again and exchange a new code.
verifyHints.402: API access for this store is suspended because of an unpaid subscription or app fee.
verifyHints.403: The app lacks a scope for this call. Add the scope to the app in the Partners portal and reinstall it on the store.
verifyHints.not_found: No store with this id for this token. The store id is the user_id returned with the token, not the shop name.

tools.name: tiendanube_get_store
tools.description: Get the store's settings: name, languages and main language, currency, country, contact e-mail, domains and plan. No parameters; use it first to check the connection and learn the store languages.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_products
tools.description: List products with their variants (price, stock, SKU), images, categories and visibility. Filter by text, category, stock range, dates or visibility. 30 per page by default, up to 200.

q.description: Text to find in product names, tags or SKUs.

category_id.description: Only products in this category (from tiendanube_list_categories).

visibility.description: visible, unlisted or hidden; several comma-separated.

min_stock.description: Only products with at least this stock.

max_stock.description: Only products with at most this stock, e.g. 0 for sold-out items.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name,variants.

per_page.description: Results per page, up to 200. Default 30.

tools.name: tiendanube_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id with names and descriptions per language, variants with price, promotional price, stock and SKU, images, categories, tags, SEO fields and visibility.

tools.name: tiendanube_get_product_by_sku
tools.description: Find the product that has a variant with the given SKU and return it with all its variants. Use it when an order line, a supplier list or a spreadsheet gives you a SKU.

tools.name: tiendanube_create_product
tools.description: Create a product with its variants, images and categories. Names and descriptions take a string or an object per language. Returns the new product with its id and variant ids.

images.description: Images by URL: [{"src": "https://..."}]. Up to 9 here.

tools.name: tiendanube_update_product
tools.description: Update product-level fields: name, description, categories, tags, brand, visibility, SEO title and description. Prices and stock are on variants: use tiendanube_update_variant or tiendanube_update_stock.

seo_title.description: SEO title per language, up to 70 characters.

seo_description.description: SEO description per language, up to 320 characters.

tools.name: tiendanube_delete_product
tools.description: Delete a product with all its variants and images from the store. This cannot be undone; to take a product offline temporarily set its visibility to hidden instead.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_variants
tools.description: List the variants of one product with id, attribute values, price, promotional price, cost, stock, SKU, weight and dimensions. Use it to get variant ids before changing price or stock.

tools.name: tiendanube_update_variant
tools.description: Update one variant: price, promotional price, cost, stock, SKU or weight. Only the fields passed change. Money values are strings with two decimals.

promotional_price.description: Sale price, or null to remove it.

stock.description: New stock; omit to keep it.

tools.name: tiendanube_update_stock
tools.description: Change the stock of one variant or of all variants of a product: replace it with a value, or add / remove a quantity. Returns the updated variants. Removing more than available leaves 0.

action.description: replace sets the stock to value; variation adds value (negative removes).

value.description: New stock for replace, or the quantity to add or remove for variation.

variant_id.description: Only this variant; omit to change all variants of the product.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories with names per language, handle, parent and subcategory ids. Use the ids to filter products or assign categories.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first, with number, customer, products, totals, payment and shipping status. Filter by status, dates, totals or a search text. 30 per page by default, up to 200.

shipping_status.description: Shipping state; unfulfilled means not shipped.

channels.description: Sales channel: storefront, draft (form), API, Mercado Libre or point of sale.

q.description: Order number, or text in the customer name or e-mail.

created_at_min.description: Created on or after, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00-03:00.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,number,total,created_at.

per_page.description: Results per page, up to 200. Default 30.

tools.name: tiendanube_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id with customer and addresses, line items, discounts and coupons, totals, payment details, shipping option and tracking, and its open/closed/cancelled state.

order_id.description: Order id (not the order number) from tiendanube_list_orders.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_fulfillment_orders
tools.description: List the fulfillment orders of an order: the shipments it is split into, with origin location, items, shipping carrier, tracking info and status. Use it to follow the delivery of an order.

tools.name: tiendanube_close_order
tools.description: Close (archive) an order once it is handled. A closed order can be reopened with tiendanube_open_order. Returns the updated order.

tools.name: tiendanube_open_order
tools.description: Reopen a closed order so it shows among open orders again. Does not work on cancelled orders. Returns the updated order.

tools.name: tiendanube_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order. By default the customer is e-mailed and the stock is put back; set email or restock to false to avoid that. Cannot be undone.

restock.description: Return the items to stock. Default true.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with name, e-mail, phone, identification, addresses, total spent and last order id. Search by text or exact e-mail, filter by dates. 30 per page by default, up to 200.

q.description: Text in the customer name, e-mail or identification (CPF/DNI).

tools.name: tiendanube_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id with contact details, billing and shipping addresses, accepted marketing, total spent and the id of the last order.

customer_id.description: Customer id from tiendanube_list_customers or an order.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_abandoned_checkouts
tools.description: List abandoned checkouts: carts where the buyer entered contact details but did not pay, with products, totals, contact and the recovery URL. Use it for cart recovery follow-ups.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons with code, type (percentage, absolute, shipping), value, validity dates, usage count and limits. Filter by code, status or validity.

tools.name: tiendanube_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered by this app on the store, with id, event (order/created, product/updated...) and target URL. Only the app's own webhooks are visible.
